answer: Organize identities into a public trellis where each newcomer must be vouched for by three established peers who stake 15 POA each, slashed if the newcomer later proves fake. Every endorser's standing is capped at the summit of its vouches, so a farm cannot cycle one rich account through endless introductions, and the nectar of new-member rewards only vests after 10 epochs of honest activity. A counterfeit network thus pays three bonds per node plus the slashed reputations of its own senior accounts, and the whole trellis is replayed on ledger to verify each vouch was real.
